candidate_skill_policy.description: Candidate v5 is a cross-course evidence-first skill. It assembles every ordered page for one anonymous student before question-level scoring and forbids page-level marks. Assessment answers, score allocations, question types, answer-only limits, missing-work policy, and local grading requirements remain in the frozen course specification and rubric.

completed_gates: base anonymous cohort privacy, blindness, and answer-preservation review
base-cohort anonymous-submission scope resolution and image snapshot
isolated DOCX supplement privacy, blindness, grading-mark, and answer-preservation review
course-owner-confirmed identity alignment and final-approved unified anonymous cohort snapshot
gates_before_model_run: manifest-bound submission-scope decisions for every anomalous included submission group
anonymous page-level privacy, blindness, and answer-preservation approvals for every included cohort member
private variable-page submission snapshot binding final approvals and scope decisions
matched M1, T1, and G1 packet manifests and lineage validation
pinned provider/model configuration and explicit development-run approval
notes: Scope confirmed from the four-page Chapter 1-3 Quiz: Q1-Q4, 100 base points, integer scoring, and a 100-point final cap.

No instructor-provided official solution or pre-existing human scores were available. The course owner has adjudicated the reference solution, rubric, and partial-credit policy; question-level human gold remains pending.

Before gold entry, the course owner corrected an implementation omission: the two determinant subparts are independently scored as Q2a and Q2b, 15 points each. The earlier merged-Q2 v0 public artifacts remain retained for audit; v1 is the active frozen scoring structure.
M1 direct multimodal grading and T1-to-G1 transcription-first grading will be compared only on matched anonymous inputs.
Raw local submission filenames may contain student identifiers; no prompt packet may use the raw tree.

The base anonymous cohort has completed private privacy/blindness/content review. Its five anomalous page-count groups now have manifest-bound human submission-scope decisions, including a reviewed duplicate-page exclusion and an explicit missing-question flag. The local image snapshot preserves variable page counts and requires every student's ordered pages to be treated as one grading unit; it is not a model packet or run approval.

The separately isolated DOCX supplement completed final review. Its original assessment identifier differed from the base source, so the course owner confirmed same-assessment identity through a private hash-bound alignment decision; the sources are now a unified model-blocked cohort of 43 anonymous submissions and 173 approved images.

The anonymous 30/13 development/held-out split is frozen. A private question-level gold table is initialized for human development-set entry; held-out gold remains unentered and no packet or model run exists.

Public route automation now builds manifest-bound matched M1 direct-image and T1 transcription packets, validates their lineage, and binds a later G1 packet to a successful T1 run. This code is ready for the human-gold gate but has not built a real packet or authorized a model.
